collection.title: Vauxhall Insignia Saloon 2008 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Insignia Saloon 2009 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 18" blade for the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
